title: Financial Model Build for Startups and SMEs
summary: Three-statement models with scenarios, budgets and fundraising or expansion cases, handed over so your team can own them.
metaDescription: Fixed-fee financial model builds for startups and SMEs: three-statement models, scenarios, budgets, fundraising and expansion cases, with a handover session.
heroIntro: A clear, checked financial model for a raise, an expansion or a budget, built to be understood and owned by your team.
overview: A model is only useful if people trust it and can change it. We build in Excel with a clear assumptions sheet and built-in checks, test scenarios with you, and hand over with a session so your team can run it without us.
whatWeDo: Handover session so your team can own it.
whoFor: SMEs planning an expansion or a bank facility.
Finance teams that need a budget model they can maintain.
note: CFO-tier clients get up to 12 hours a year of financial modelling support included.

faqs.q: What tool are models built in?
faqs.a: Excel, with a clear assumptions sheet and checks, so your team can open and maintain it.

faqs.q: Will I be able to change the model myself?
faqs.a: Yes. We hand over with a session and documentation so your team can own it.
